participation.context: Accepted the one reading, kept the loaf at a finger short, and said the house stays shut.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Owned the relish, and refused a second reading.
participation.name: Master Josias Thwaite

participation.context: Set the house to fish, and told him not to come home with a story instead of an appetite.
participation.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

participation.context: Asked whether standing still was enough, and went to set the fish.
participation.name: Alse Pinder

relations.note: the commination was read once, with relish, and will not be repeated for him
relations.quote: I shall not read the commination a second time for a man who has already heard it and wants it quieter.

story.body: You left the reading where Thwaite had put it. You named the company idle. You refused to carry his curses to the players, and you said you would look at a cold stage.

relations.note: the commination was read once, with relish, and will not be repeated for him
relations.quote: I shall not read the commination a second time for a man who has already heard it and wants it quieter.

description: The office, and not a second reading

participation.context: Stood the office and left the almanac blank under the line.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You stood through evening prayer and wrote nothing in the margin.

title: Stood at evening prayer

participation.context: Paid threepence, refused a second reading, and said he had not crossed.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Set the fish and the price, and told him not to improve it.
participation.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

participation.context: Counted the trenchers, and kept the threepence.
participation.name: Alse Pinder

relations.note: supper is fish at threepence, and the cold stage stays in Shoreditch
relations.quote: A cold stage is not a caller if it stays in Shoreditch.

story.body: You ate the fish, paid threepence, and said you had not crossed. You did not turn the supper into a second reading.
